title: Fix XRechnung export truncating item name to 40 characters
summary: XRechnung export now includes the full item description instead of truncating it to 40 characters, allowing up to 100 characters as permitted by the specification.
key_points: Removed 40-character limit on item names in XRechnung export for sales invoices and credit memos
Full description field (up to 100 characters) is now exported without truncation
Complies with XRechnung 3.0.2 specification and UBL 2.1 schema which have no length restriction on BT-153
Added tests verifying that maximum-length item descriptions are properly exported
